deploy.startCommand: sh -c "echo '=== Checking alembic version ===' && python3 -c 'import asyncpg, os, asyncio; async def check(): conn = await asyncpg.connect(os.environ["DATABASE_URL"]); row = await conn.fetchrow("SELECT version_num FROM alembic_version"); await conn.close(); print("Current alembic version:", row["version_num"] if row else "none"); asyncio.run(check())' 2>&1 && echo '=== Running alembic upgrade heads ===' && alembic upgrade heads 2>&1 && echo '=== Checking tables ===' && python3 /app/check_columns.py 2>&1 && echo '=== Starting uvicorn ===' && uvicorn api.main:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port ${PORT:-8000}"
